field.name: orderBy
field.comment: display_asc: the pages are listed in the order of the sitemap; display_desc: in the reverse order; chrono_asc: by date, oldest first; chrono_desc: by date, most recent first; alpha_asc: by name; alpha_desc: by name, reversed

field.name: displayPages
field.comment: top, second_level, third_level: the navigation starts at that level of the site; above, current, below: at the level of the page holding the block, above it or below it; custom: at the displayPagesCID page

field.name: displayPagesCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the navigation starts from (used if displayPages is custom)

field.name: displaySubPages
field.comment: none: no child page is listed; relevant: the ones under the current page are listed; relevant_breadcrumb: its breadcrumb trail is listed too; all: every child page is listed

field.name: displaySubPageLevels
field.comment: enough: the child pages are listed down to the current page; enough_plus1: one level deeper; all: down to the deepest one; custom: displaySubPageLevelsNum levels deep

field.name: displaySubPageLevelsNum
field.comment: How many levels of child pages are listed (used if displaySubPageLevels is custom)

field.name: displayUnavailablePages
field.comment: true: the pages that the visitor may not be allowed to view are listed too; false: they are left out
